describe: The image shows a rounded, mottled patch of teal-green, with darker green-black mottling near the centre and paler grey-teal towards the outer edge. Faint orange-brown streaks run through the left centre, and lighter cyan patches sit towards the lower middle. Brightness is mid to low, with a soft circular vignette fading to the surround. Transparency is unclear, since the outer area is a flat pale grey-teal.
